items.title: The Unitree of It All: Why China IPO Surge Is Good News for Tesla
items.summary: If humanoid robots are the future, and they appear to be based on what investors are willing to pay, then Elon Musk faces a formidable Chinese rival.  Unitree Robotics  surged 460% on Wednesday in its trading debut in Shanghai, giving the company a market capitalization of about $51 billion.  Figure AI, which posts videos of its robots working in factories, has been valued at almost $40 billion.
